verdict.line: You lose if you let Ornn farm Searing Charge knockups off walls and stall to items; you win if you chain E into Q before he can set up, since the numbers (53% WR, 115 games) favour you early and the shape goes even only once he scales.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's E (Death's Grasp) pull plus single-target Q (Obliterate) burst punishes a melee champion whose only gap-close, E (Searing Charge), is conditional on hitting terrain for its knockup. That gives Morde the lane and solo-kill edge measured here, but Ornn's passive bonus Armor/MR and anywhere-forged items let him close the gap by the time both ultimates are live.

theirWindow.when: Ornn lands Q then angles toward a wall
theirWindow.what: Volcanic Rupture slows you and drops a delayed magma pillar at its end point; if he's also walking toward terrain he's setting up Searing Charge's collision shockwave for a full slow-into-knockup combo. Back off the wall rather than trading face-to-face.

yourWindow.when: Ornn's E (Searing Charge) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With his only dash down he can't close distance or threaten the knockup shockwave. Walk up and land E (Death's Grasp) to pull him in, then Obliterate for the single-target damage bonus.

start.why: Run in 76.8% of games at 56.6% win rate over 106 games — the mana/AP sustain lets you contest Ornn's Q poke without losing the trade war.

boots.why: 50% pick rate at 56.1% win rate over 66 games; Ornn's kit is slow-and-knockup heavy (Q slow, E shockwave, R Brittle), so the tenacity directly cuts his control windows.

core.why: Highest-winrate path start (76.9% over 13 games); the slow on Q and E lets you lock Ornn in E (Death's Grasp) range for longer.
Core second item in the top path; sustained damage and the omnivamp keep you healthy through extended trades once W (Indestructible) is on cooldown.
Closes out the 76.9%-winrate core path; burn damage scales against Ornn's passive bonus Armor/MR since it isn't mitigated the same way.

you fall behind and need armor plus tenacity to survive his engage

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks off repeated autos and spell hits during the E-into-Q trade pattern, converting into adaptive force and sustain exactly when you're locked into melee range with Ornn — the 65.5% winrate page over the alternative confirms this is the stronger line.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 69.6% of games at 57.4% win rate and converts your measured solo-kill advantage into secured early kills; Flash+Teleport (56.3%, 23.7% pick) is the alternative if you expect to need wave control for scaling into Rylai's/Riftmaker.

playing.title: Chain E into Q every trade
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls Ornn into your face before he can reposition, and Obliterate's damage is increased when it hits a single target — always land the pull first.

playing.title: Play off walls, not into them
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain; stay away from lane walls so his E is just a pass-through hit with no shockwave.

playing.title: Track his W for the passive block
playing.detail: OP.GG flags that Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) can block your Darkness Rise passive from triggering — don't assume your third hit procs the aura if he's mid-dash through you.

playing.title: Hold W shield through the exchange
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken over its duration; don't consume it for healing the instant you're hit, let it build through the full trade first.

playing.title: Save R for a confirmed all-in
playing.detail: Realm of Death starts at a 140s cooldown — only use it once Ornn is already slowed or pulled in, since whiffing it costs you over two minutes with no backup play.

playing.title: Deny his forge resets pre-6
playing.detail: Living Forge lets Ornn buy items from anywhere on the map; avoid overextending the wave so he can't casually reset and forge up without losing lane presence.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and summoner picks above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-pattern reasoning, cooldown call-outs, and the wall/Searing Charge interaction are my own tactical read, not measured stats.

stats.opponentTip: Although Ornn is an easy opponent to lane against, his (W) can block your [P]. Do not let this happen.
